Read from the floating window. Your camera controls recording.

1. Write or import a script and choose your text size and pace. Everything is saved on this phone.

2. Tap Open over camera. The first time, allow Near to display over other apps.

3. In Pixel Camera, choose Video and switch to the front camera. Drag the reader by its top bar so it sits just below the lens.

4. Start recording in your camera, then tap Play in the reader. Tap Pause at any time. Swipe the text to move back or ahead.

The reader’s controls let you restart, change pace or text size, and close the window. Closing or pausing the reader does not stop your camera recording.

Voice-follow scrolling is planned for a later version.

Keep the reader close to the lens. A few words per line will help your eyes stay focused.

When you are ready, open the reader over your camera and make your first take.
